content.short: Artistic assets with random airdrops that crate ways of acquiring physical art and more
content.description:
Using our passion for art to strengthen the Cardano community we have a vision of you getting excited about opening up your wallets and discovering random pieces of art as well as Taos family Tokens that you can trade for Artworks, prints, merchandise, custom tailored pfps, raffles, Ada, and more to come.

Our goal is to continue to create fun ways of acquiring one of a kind Artworks threw digital collectables, and using open source tools to offer a way to claim digital collectables after purchasing Artworks with fiat.
